page.content:
Old Kingdom spells carved in royal burial chambers.

How Pyramid Texts connects

  • Location: Pyramids of Giza — Pyramid Texts developed in Old Kingdom royal pyramids, the ideology Giza embodies.

What is Pyramid Texts?

The Pyramid Texts are the oldest large body of Egyptian religious writing, meant to send the dead king to the sky and the company of Ra and Osiris.

Key threads lead to Pyramids of Giza.
